verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a web API for managing and exporting account-level data (sentry-docs-14, sentry-docs-20) and is open source with a self-hosted option that lets users run everything themselves without vendor dependency (sentry-docs-11, sentry-docs-37, corroborated by sentry-comm-1 and sentry-comm-2 on the open-source/self-hosted experience). This supports data portability and 'leaving' without lock-in, but there's no explicit documentation of a full bulk data-export feature in open formats (e.g., CSV/JSON export of all issues, traces, dashboards) beyond the generic API. Missing for 10: an explicit 'export all your data' feature/doc, named open export formats, and independent confirmation that the API supports full data export rather than just account management.
